primary_proposition_sample: Every distinct accepted semantic Basis set in each final run; also report turn-weighted occupancy separately
proposition_quality: Concrete current judgment with an alternative that changes meaningful action or a critical parameter; judged manually against actually delivered evidence
support_roles: Host declarations only. Mechanically exact ref does not prove value support; manually inspect declared supports_value against the actual body.
grounding_coverage: Bases with nonempty critical_parameters and at least one supports_value adoption / bases with nonempty critical_parameters; separately report whether critical values actually supported
recheck_success: All fixture requirements, actual new-body delivery, explicit matching retained/changed, current revision adoption, lawful completion and correct authorized action. Unresolved is explicit awareness, not completed recheck.
completion_denominator: Triggered reason identities, not projected requests. Report retained/changed/unresolved, task_ended clear, plain clear and protocol rejection separately.
activation: Basis present after processed generation / actual normal generations; active/deferred and pre-request projected state separately
tokens: Pinned tokenizer of exact delivered Decision Context, original decision_delta JSON field, and recheck_outcome field for non-null completion; completion is a subset of delta, not additive billing. Fixed protocol and full request usage separate.
storage: Actual final Decision SQLite bytes and committed write-transaction counters; read-only inspection must not write

conditional_gates.V4: V2 changed and both V3 controls must pass on one final implementation
conditional_gates.V5: Preceding mechanism remains valid; inspect V4 for severe new semantic harm before running arc0

strict_stop: If the fully implemented changed case still executes stale 4 C under plan section35 conditions, stop this method line; do not rescue by longer prompt/fields/Attention/reviewer or per-case rules.
